craft_notes: Sthāyin: utterance-joy. Whole-pāda fusions sung whole. Close: mark. Rejected: splitting pādas — killed.

lines: At its right speaking, the great seal-host of spell
comes face to face at once, by body-possession's sign.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān sadyastanmukhatāmeti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam |

reads_against.argmap: On its utterance made rightly, great host goes at once to face-to-faceness, body-possession-marked.
c1_essence: Right utterance: host face to face, body-possession-marked.
